title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 05/14 — "Our Advertisement Brings a Visitor"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 5. Holmes has put an advertisement in every evening paper, in Watson's name, and told him to load his revolver.

Told in Watson's own voice, cut to under three minutes. A wedding ring fell to the floor when the dead man was lifted, and the papers never mentioned it — so the murderer does not know it has been found. At eight o'clock the bell rings at 221B. What comes up the stair is not the man of violence they are waiting for, but a very old and wrinkled woman who curtseys, blinks at the light, and claims the ring for her daughter Sally. Holmes follows her out into Baker Street. He is gone three hours, and comes back laughing at himself.

SOURCE
"A Study in Scarlet" by Arthur Conan Doyle, first published 1887. This episode adapts Chapter V, "Our Advertisement Brings a Visitor". The book is in the public domain. Full text from Project Gutenberg: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/244

HOW THIS WAS MADE
Every picture and every voice in this video is generated with AI. The words are adapted from Arthur Conan Doyle's text and edited by a person; the narration is a synthetic voice, not a recording of anyone; no shot is footage of a real person, a real place or a real event. This video is also declared as altered or synthetic content in YouTube's own disclosure field.
